summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 and nine-month 2026 earnings release and consolidated financial statements. The report is operational and financial in nature: record quarterly production of 95,557 GEO, 253,131 GEO year-to-date, net revenue of $385.98 million in Q3, nine-month Adjusted EBITDA of $677.4 million, and net debt to LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 0.20x. No transaction, shareholder solicitation, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings current report, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
